items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-10,400 (levels 1-17). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Flame Dash T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Rapid Recharge. Ultimate (Concussive Combustion) is available from Spirit Lifesteal.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 10400 souls (~10.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spiritual Overflow, 22400 souls (~22.4 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Rapid Recharge completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Rapid Recharge completes 4.8k spirit in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Napalm (1 to 2).

items.name: Swift Striker
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spiritual Overflow, 19200 souls (~19.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Adds 1 more charge to Napalm (3 to 4), Flame Dash (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 10,400-28,800 (levels 17-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Napalm T3, Concussive Combustion T3. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Enduring Speed, weapon 4.8k at Spiritual Overflow.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Flame Dash: its duration-scaled parts (duration 3s, ground flame duration 5s) get +22%. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you. Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Concussive Combustion stun duration (2.1s), Afterburn build up duration (17s), Napalm debuff duration (8s). Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k, 8k tiers): bonus 12 to 62% weapon damage. Upgrade of Spirit Lifesteal (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 28,800-57,600 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Afterburn T3.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Flame Dash (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown. Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Flame Dash: resets its 26s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Dash into the middle of them, ult, and live through it.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.
sections.desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Kelvin, Geist, Vyper.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Their healer keeps your burn target alive.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Replaces Dispel Magic: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Concussive Combustion deals damage (damage), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Takes spirit from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Replaces Swift Striker: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 29.2 to Concussive Combustion's damage (0.97x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
